match.userMessage:
A cinematic establishing shot. Opening scene: Scene 1 — 18s

Shot 1 — 6s
INT. DOWNTOWN APARTMENT BATHROOM — MORNING. Hard sunlight cuts across white tile and a black stone sink. Scarlett, a sharp-eyed city influencer in a black turtleneck, tears open a coral lipstick carton with one hand while her phone buzzes beside it. The handheld camera drifts with her movement as she catches the tube before it rolls into the sink.

Shot 2 — 6s
Overhead on the sink: the coral lipstick, a silver metro card, black sunglasses, and a single green hair clip Art style: Modern social-first product photography with tactile, editorial energy. Products shown in real-life context -- hands opening packaging, fingers pressing textures, products on bathroom shelves, kitchen counters, rumpled linen. Close-up detail shots emphasize material and finish. Flat-lays with curated minimal arrangements. Color-matched backgrounds that complement the product. Every frame feels like something you would screenshot and save. Mood: Fresh, sensory, and effortlessly cool. Lighting: Bright natural window light with clean directional shadows. Direct on-camera flash for punchy editorial energy on select shots. No heavy diffusion -- let light feel real and immediate. Warm late-afternoon glow for lifestyle moments. High-key and airy overall with pops of contrast. No text, no titles, no subtitles, no watermarks, no letters, no words, no signs, no UI elements.
